The mid-tuning frequency is about 10% short (2.18 GHz against a 2.4 GHz target). All other specs pass with margin: power is 0.46 mW of the 1.1 mW allowed, the tuning ratio is 35 against 29, and swing is 1.82 V against 1.46 V. The topology is fine, so stronger starving devices should close the gap. The floor resistor mostly sets f_lo, so the tuning ratio should hold.
